name: Low-vol anomaly tilt — 4h calm swing (spot)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the low-vol anomaly at a 4h swing horizon — a faster expression of the same tilt so it partly reconciles the slow-anomaly premium with the sniper mandate, and tests whether the calm-name edge survives at a shorter hold where fee drag rises): 2025-2026 evidence (432 coins, Binance spot, 2018-2025) shows low-realized-vol coins earn better risk-adjusted returns because leverage-averse retail overpays for high-vol lottery names, underpricing the calm ones. Entry: vol_realized below a fitted ceiling (calm name) AND atr below a fitted ceiling (low-range confirmation) AND range_position below a fitted ceiling (not extended into a high). Hold the calm regime for a swing rather than weeks. The counterparty is the lottery-ticket degen; the leverage constraint sustains the mispricing. SPOT-only (matches the study). Exit: atr crosses up through a fitted level (range expanding, calm regime ending) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if the excess return dies net of fees vs buy-and-hold BTC, it's disguised beta not a premium — and at 4h the fee drag is heavier, so this is the harder cost test. DISCONFIRMER 2: a HIGH-vol tilt matching over the same sample => unstable sign => curve-fit. DISCONFIRMER 3: if the 1d version of this tilt already clears and the 4h does not add distinct return, this is redundant timeframe noise, not a separate edge.
catalyst: a calm low-vol name held for a swing while the crowd overpays for lottery names
